{
  "candidate_rtl": "module crc32_d8 (
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    // Fold each incoming bit into the corresponding low state bit once.
    wire [7:0] x;
    assign x = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant-only symbolic evaluation of eight reflected Galois steps.
    // Bits 0..31 select state outputs; bits 32..39 select data outputs.
    function automatic [7:0] contribution_mask(input integer index);
        reg [7:0] s [0:31];
        reg [7:0] d [0:7];
        reg [7:0] feedback;
        reg [31:0] poly;
        integer i, k;
        begin
            poly = 32'hedb88320;
            for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
                s[i] = 8'b0;
                if (i < 8)
                    s[i] = 8'b1 << i;
            end
            for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0];
                d[k] = feedback;
                for (i = 0; i < 31; i = i + 1)
                    s[i] = s[i+1];
                s[31] = 8'b0;
                for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1)
                    if (poly[i])
                        s[i] = s[i] ^ feedback;
            end
            if (index < 32)
                contribution_mask = s[index];
            else
                contribution_mask = d[index-32];
        end
    endfunction

    // Return the ordinal-th selected input, or -1 for an unused leaf.
    function automatic integer selected_bit(
        input [7:0] mask,
        input integer ordinal
    );
        integer i, count;
        begin
            selected_bit = -1;
            count = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                if (mask[i]) begin
                    if (count == ordinal)
                        selected_bit = i;
                    count = count + 1;
                end
            end
        end
    endfunction

    genvar o, j;
    generate
        for (o = 0; o < 40; o = o + 1) begin : output_tree
            localparam [7:0] MASK = contribution_mask(o);
            wire [15:0] leaf;
            wire [7:0] level1;
            wire [3:0] level2;
            wire [1:0] level3;
            wire result;

            if (o < 24) begin : shifted_state
                assign leaf[0] = state_in[o+8];
            end else begin : no_shifted_state
                assign leaf[0] = 1'b0;
            end

            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : selected_terms
                localparam integer BIT_INDEX = selected_bit(MASK, j);
                if (BIT_INDEX >= 0) begin : present
                    assign leaf[j+1] = x[BIT_INDEX];
                end else begin : absent
                    assign leaf[j+1] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign leaf[15:9] = 7'b0;

            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : first_level
                assign level1[j] = leaf[2*j] ^ leaf[2*j+1];
            end
            for (j = 0; j < 4; j = j + 1) begin : second_level
                assign level2[j] = level1[2*j] ^ level1[2*j+1];
            end
            for (j = 0; j < 2; j = j + 1) begin : third_level
                assign level3[j] = level2[2*j] ^ level2[2*j+1];
            end
            assign result = level3[0] ^ level3[1];

            if (o < 32) begin : state_result
                assign state_out[o] = result;
            end else begin : data_result
                assign data_out[o-32] = result;
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The original expresses each output as a parity of independent state and data inputs. Repeated state/data pairs can increase XOR-network size and routing fanout, while synthesis-selected parity decomposition determines the critical arrival time.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the reflected eight-bit update by first computing x = data_in XOR state_in[7:0]. Generate constant contribution masks for all 40 outputs, compact their selected terms, and use explicit balanced XOR trees. Incorporate the untouched shifted upper state directly into each applicable output tree rather than adding it after the parity tree. Mask generation is elaboration-only; no runtime iteration or storage is inferred.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended gain comes from sharing eight input XORs and bounding the subsequent parity depth. No numerical timing improvement is claimed: mapping may restructure the trees, and shared-input fanout may offset depth or area benefits. The specified mapped timing run is required to establish improvement.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Input-pair factoring is intended to reduce duplicated XOR work without an aggressive area-expanding transformation. Buffering of shared x signals may add area. The 2752.640000 um^2 cap, full native and mapped SAT equivalence, and zero electrical violations have not been measured or verified here and remain required acceptance checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the crc32_d8 port names, widths, and directions. All 40 inputs remain unconstrained. All 32 state outputs and all eight data outputs are computed, including feedback contributions from earlier bits within the byte. The design implements reflected polynomial 0xedb88320, corresponding to 0x04c11db7, with feed-forward disabled. It assumes no initialization, reset, framing, inversion, or valid gating and contains no sequential state, memories, external dependencies, or formal constraints."
}
